cloudOff.name: thread_rename
cloudOff.description: Names the thread (by id, or a prefix of it) in the agent's own store on the machine, the field the agent writes when a person renames the session inside it, so the thread reads by that name in wsp and in the agent. outcome renamed means the store took it; unsupported means the thread's agent keeps no name of a person's, which is an answer, not an error; no-session means the agent's store on the machine has no such session; failed means the store refused the write and error carries the machine's own line for it. Whether an agent keeps a name is on its row in harnesses.list, from the adapter on the machine.
